title.zh: 【高盛将国债基金 FTIXX 引入 Avalanche 许可链 Lynq】 Foresight News 消息，Avalanche 发推表示，高盛将其 1000
title.en: 【高盛将国债基金 FTIXX 引入 Avalanche 许可链 Lynq】 Foresight News 消息，Avalanche 发推表示，高盛将其 1000

current_state.zh: Goldman Sachs is bringing its roughly $100 billion treasury fund FTIXX onto Lynq, a permissioned Avalanche L1 that already hosts over 30 institutional participants, with trading handled by licensed broker tZERO Securities for eligible US clients.
